value.rationale: The order-3 L-stable Radau IIA end-step can lose Markov positivity and regain it at larger timesteps. An exact, dimension-only twelve-state threshold across all balanced multipartite topologies, and explicit polynomial bounds of the resulting forbidden window, materially sharpen generic step-size guarantees in a natural spectral test family. The statement is not merely a finite table or trivial substitution.
